summary: This bill allows certain rural community hospitals that participated in a demonstration program to be designated as critical access hospitals, waiving the standard distance requirements for a one-year period.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to waive certain distance requirements for rural community hospitals to be designated as critical access hospitals under Medicare. This would allow more rural hospitals to receive enhanced Medicare reimbursement, thereby supporting their financial viability and access to healthcare services in rural areas. This expands access to healthcare, which leans towards more public healthcare.
